snippet.title: Very Safe Dino Park - Official Game Announcement!
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4311530/Very_Safe_Dino_Park

Welcome to the Very Safe Dino Park.

A chaotic 1 to 4 player dinosaur park sim where feeding the dinos, cleaning the mess, and surviving the chaos are all part of the job.

Build, manage, and barely survive your own prehistoric theme park in this chaotic 1 to 4 player co-op simulator. Feed dinosaurs, clean up “incidents,” keep the guests under control, and hold everything together with duct tape and poor decisions.

Nothing can go wrong but life finds a way.

Open the gates. Sell the tickets. Pretend everything is fine.

Behind the scenes?

- Dinosaurs are getting hungry
- Guests are getting annoying
- Systems are definitely failing

Keep the park running, or watch it spiral into a very expensive mistake.

Your dinosaurs are incredible, majestic and constantly seconds away from ruining your life.

- Step into enclosures to feed and manage them
- Clean up mountains of poop
- Keep them calm before they break out
- Tranquilise anything with too many teeth and a bad attitude

If they get hungry, they will hunt. You are not special.

Guests are the reason you’re here and everything is under control!

- Sell tickets and overpriced merch
- Keep vending machines stocked
- Clean up litter, spills, and suspicious limbs
- Deal with troublemakers however you see fit

You can escort them out politely. Or speed up the food chain.

And it will break. Constantly.

- Scrub bloodstains and mystery puddles
- Keep the park clean
- Turn dino poop into biofuel
- Keep the power on at all costs

Because when the power goes out… the fences do too.

Start small. Mess up fast. Expand anyway.

- Unlock new dinosaurs
- Build enclosures
- Add facilities and decorations
- Automate repetitive tasks

Turn your park into a world-class attraction… or a cautionary tale.

Work together like a well-oiled machine. Or don’t.

- 1 to 4 player chaotic co-op
- Coordinate tasks… or ruin everything
- Throw poop at your friends
- Lock them in enclosures
- Tranquilise them for absolutely no reason

Dinosaurs are dangerous. Your friends are worse.
